title: Using for 2 years
body:
EDIT: When I change the date on a recurring task it doesn’t ask me if I want to change all its instances and changes only the one I’ve selected. Please fix that! 🙏 (iPhone 11, version 15.6.1)

The app is cool and is essentially here to cover the gap that the users were covering setting reminders on Google calendar. It’s nice that you can transfer the reminders from Calendar to Tasks right away but there is still something that Tasks needs to solve. Tasks are visible on the Calendar in browser but not in the Calendar app. So if you were used to seeing your daily meetings along with reminders for the day now this is not possible in the Calendar app yet. Another detail would be to be able to set the date for a task as today with just one click. Or maybe today should be the default date when adding a new task. Other than that the app is very smooth!
author: Ntrigintrigi

title: Great but needs improvements
body: I enjoy this app a lot. I find it however frustrating that when adding subtasks they cannot be visually minimized and appear visually along with the main tasks. As I really add a lot of subtasks it is a bit tiring to the eye. I wish there was a drop down/up feature for them.
